name: @w6w-apps/gorgias
description: Manage Gorgias tickets, customers, messages, tags, views and satisfaction surveys.

w6w.longDescription:
Gorgias is a helpdesk built for ecommerce. This app covers the ticket lifecycle from a workflow — creating, updating, fetching, listing and deleting tickets, and posting both internal notes and customer-facing replies to keep a conversation moving without an agent opening Gorgias directly.

Customers can be created, updated, fetched, listed and deleted, so a workflow can look up or create the requester behind a ticket. Tags can be listed, created and deleted, and can be attached to a ticket at creation time. Views (Gorgias's saved ticket filters) can be listed and retrieved so a workflow can react to the same queues an agent works from. Satisfaction surveys — CSAT scores tied to a ticket and customer — can be listed, created, fetched and updated.

A fit for routing an external event — an order issue, a form submission, an alert from another system — into a new Gorgias ticket, updating tickets as a workflow progresses, or syncing customer data and CSAT results between Gorgias and the rest of a support stack.
